body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Haier launched its slim designed full HD TV 'T1 Series' at 2009 CES, which offers full HD 1080p experience with 120Hz and LED backlight technology and SRS TruSurround XT Sound. The four HDMI inputs allow you to hook up your set top cable box, gaming machine, Blu-ray or DVD player, video camera, computer and more to get the fullest line of entertainment possible.
